question: Segments \(AC\) and \(BD\) intersect at \(O\). Given \(AB\parallel CD\), \(OA=3\), \(OC=6\), and \(AB=4\), find the length of \(CD\).
solution: Since \(AB\parallel CD\), \(\triangle OAB\sim\triangle OCD\) (figure-eight configuration). Thus, \(OA/OC=AB/CD\), or \(3/6=4/CD\), giving \(CD=8\).
